items.title: Joint-Border commission finds colonial boundary pegs in Sandu
items.summary: By Hatab Nyang Boundary teams from The Gambia and Senegal have found four colonial-era markers in Sandu District as work continues to identify and clarify parts of the border between the two countries. The National Council for Arts and Culture (NCAC) said the search was carrie...
